name: KinetRig (AI Remotion Video Production Engine)
description: AI-powered motion graphics and cinematic video production engine using Remotion (React). Converts prompts, scene concepts, and parameters into high-quality Remotion compositions with automatic MP4 rendering and instant media player preview.
ai_instructions:
Follow the official KinetRig Remotion workflow (https://github.com/Reff33/KinetRig):

1. CORE PRINCIPLES:
   • Remotion React Core: Compositions are authored as pure, deterministic React components using Remotion. Timing driven by useCurrentFrame() and interpolate().
   • Deterministic Timeline: Never use Math.random() or Date.now(). Pure frame interpolation ensures 100% reproducible frame rendering.
   • Strict Vector Quality (Zero Emojis): NEVER use system emojis (🤖, ⚡, 🐙, 🧠, 🕷). Use inline SVG vectors with glowing filters, high-resolution typography, or brand assets.
   • Anti-PowerPoint Motion: Continuous camera moves (push-through, whip-pan, 3D orbit) or motivated motion wipes.
   • Automatic Player Launch: Every render automatically opens the exported MP4 in the OS default media player.

2. WORKFLOW:
   • Step 1 (Plan): Determine title, messaging, archetype (Cinematic Dark, Minimal, etc.), colors (primary, accent, bg), and aspect ratio (16:9 or 9:16 at 60 FPS).
   • Step 2 (Compose): Select or adapt template from `templates/remotion/` (e.g. `CinematicTitle.tsx`) or register composition in `remotion/Root.tsx`.
   • Step 3 (Render & Open): Execute CLI command to render MP4 and auto-launch in default media player:
     `node scripts/render-remotion.mjs <CompositionId> '{"title":"...","subtitle":"..."}'`

claude_command.name: kinet-rig
claude_command.content:
# /kinet-rig <brief> [aspect_ratio] [concept/style]

Generate AI-powered motion graphics and cinematic video with Remotion:

1. **Read Spec:** Inspect `SKILL.md` and templates under `templates/remotion/`.
2. **Plan Concept & Colors:** Establish title, subtitle, 3-color palette (primary, accent, background), and aspect ratio (16:9 or 9:16 @ 60 FPS).
3. **Render & Auto-Launch:** Execute:
   `node scripts/render-remotion.mjs CinematicTitle '{"title":"...","subtitle":"..."}'`
   This renders the MP4 and immediately opens it in the system media player.
